S1_end.note: Set A camera, last 3 frames (118-120). forward/up are world unit vectors in Set A space (Z up, +X along the groove; the cantilever axis heads 100 deg CCW from +X). screen_velocity_per_frame = motion of the world point under frame centre, in normalised frame units (x right, y up) per frame. Camera rides just above and behind the front of the brushed-aluminium cantilever looking along it (pitched ~8 deg down, rising with it); the tube is a bright neutral-silver wedge rising from bottom-centre with a thin cream streak and magenta / ultramarine side streaks.

S2_end.marble_field_input: ND.build_marble_field(tree, vec, scale=marble_scale, freq=marble_freq) with vec = Record object coords (m) (Texture Coordinate Object of the Record; z of the vinyl surface = point z). NOTE freq is NOT the ND default 2.2.
S2_end.record_rotation: clockwise seen from above, 200 deg/s; the S2 camera co-rotates exactly from f282 so f283-288 are still

set_c_marble_match.note: drop-in for handoff key set_c_marble once Set C passes freq=freq to ND.build_marble_field

S2_start.note: S2 first frame (world, set B metres). Camera rides 0.38 mm above the cantilever axis, 1 mm back from the stylus tip, looking back along the tapered tube (4 deg below horizontal; vinyl horizon ~1/3 from the top). The tube runs out of the frame bottom ~65% wide and converges toward the top edge like the S1 f120 spire, painted with the three S1 streaks (magenta left flank, saffron/cream crest, ultramarine right flank; keyed macro tint f121-125 fading out by f131). Nearly deep focus at the cut; the camera then rises + pulls back.
